title: Agents before frameworks
intro: Week 1 builds everything bare-handed — so every framework afterwards reads as convenience, not magic.

steps.title: Interchangeable brains
steps.body: The first labs hit many models through one shape: **OpenAI-compatible endpoints** — GPT, DeepSeek, Gemini, and local Llama via **Ollama** (a local service exposing the same API). Lesson one is that the model is a swappable part.

steps.title: The pattern that matters most
steps.body: **Parallel + judge**: send the task to several models at once, then let an evaluator/picker choose the best answer. The lab's own commercial note: this applies universally "where accuracy is critical" — quality is bought with tokens.

points.label: Single-shot
points.note: One model, one answer — a lottery ticket. Fine for low-stakes work.

points.label: Parallel
points.note: N candidates from N models (or N temperatures) — now you have a distribution.

points.label: Judge
points.note: An evaluator model picks the winner — accuracy-critical work earns this pattern.

steps.title: Tools make it agentic
steps.body:
The week's project — **"Professionally You"** — is your career as an agent: it answers questions from your LinkedIn profile and summary, and carries **tools**: record a question it couldn't answer, push a phone notification (Pushover) when a visitor wants contact.

The ladder: completion → workflow (fixed steps) → **agent** (the model decides which tool, when to loop, when to stop).

steps.title: Shipped, not sketched
steps.body:
The project deploys as a real **Gradio app on HuggingFace Spaces** — secrets, keys, redeploys and all.

> [!warn] Autonomy is bought with risk: every freedom granted needs a matching termination condition and guardrail. Every framework in the next five weeks is, in part, a way to formalize that.

recap:
**Agentic behavior is patterns, not a library.**

- Models are swappable behind OpenAI-compatible endpoints (Ollama for local).
- Parallel + judge is THE accuracy pattern.
- Tools + the right to decide = an agent; deploy it like real software.
- Autonomy always ships with termination conditions.
